name: Campaigns Manager

workflows.CLkKhLzNvwelxxbC: Sync Email Bison Campaigns to Hub

may_change: Hub Campaigns rows: stats and status (the syncs), Stage from Test to Scale or Test to Killed (the manager, by the standard, never Run); DNC rows with Reason Not interested

standard.dry: the newest deploy row for the campaign has Left in View = 0

description: Daily at 11:00 IL and on demand: reads every campaign with a Stage off the Hub (the syncs wrote the numbers at 07:00), applies the standard, moves Test to Scale or Test to Killed, tags dry, no-view and shared-view campaigns from the newest deploy rows, posts one message per client to #flowroots-campaigns, one run row. The syncs keep the Hub true twice a day; Sync Not Interested honors every not-interested reply as a DNC row.
